title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain: Pretraining Familiarity Survives a Contamination-Free Hold-Out
note: arXiv record, v1 only, cs.LG, two authors. Abstract: 13 forecasters (4 classical, 3 trained per dataset, 6 pretrained) on 7 groups from 5 domains, all observations said to postdate the last model release. Pretrained win 5 of 7, lose one to Theta, tie on exchange rates. Largest gain: 28% lower MASE on weekly Wikipedia pageviews. Code link: github.com/mahdinaser/tsfm-bench.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain: Pretraining Familiarity Survives a Contamination-Free Hold-Out
note: Abstract, familiarity result: seasonal strength and spectral entropy of the input window do not explain where pretrained models win. On identical series the TimesFM family outranks the Chronos family by 0.53 ranks on Wikipedia against 0.09 elsewhere (1,500 vs 754 series, Mann-Whitney p < 1e-5). No pre-registration statement on the page.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text)
note: Design: one forecast origin, 1 Jan 2026, for every group; no rolling origins. Groups: Wikipedia pageviews daily/weekly/monthly (500 series each), ERA5 weather (300, hourly), CAMS air quality (379, hourly), Danish Energinet electricity (46, hourly), ECB exchange rates (29, daily). Horizons 14 daily, 13 weekly, 8 monthly, 48 hourly. Hourly context capped at 2,016 points. No covariates.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text)
note: Models: SeasonalNaive, Theta, AutoETS, AutoARIMA; LightGBM, LSTM, N-BEATS; chronos-bolt-small, chronos-bolt-base, chronos-2, timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch, timesfm-3.0-pytorch, moirai-2.0-R-small. All methods get the same input. Paper states every checkpoint was published before the 1 Jan 2026 origin but lists no release dates, cutoffs or revision hashes.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text)
note: Numbers: Wikipedia daily TimesFM3 MASE 0.689 vs best classical 0.928 (AutoARIMA); weekly TimesFM3 1.073 vs Theta 1.499. Chronos-2 lowest MASE on weather (1.043), air quality (0.895), Wikipedia monthly (0.620). Exchange rates: Friedman test does not reject. Intervals only as Nemenyi rank plots, no numeric CIs. Pretrained 80% intervals under-cover.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text)
note: Electricity group (hourly Danish grid series incl. load and generation, 48 h horizon): Theta first, mean MASE 1.045, avg rank 5.04; Chronos-2 1.155, TimesFM3 1.157, TimesFM-2.5 1.201, LightGBM 1.260, SeasonalNaive 1.443. Authors call it no evidence of an advantage, not a deficit (under 50 series). Text gives both 46 and 47 as the series count.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text)
note: Limitations stated by the authors: familiarity is an association from one corpus and one matching domain, effect modest, offered as a hypothesis; single origin; pretraining cutoffs taken from documentation, unverified. TimesFM corpus described via its authors as mostly Wikipedia pageviews to late 2023, version not specified. Not pre-registered; series selection said to be fixed before results.
